entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about my recent order for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'd like to talk about the possibility of a return.
Certainly. I can help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01-B. The name is Mark Shapiro.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered on January 3rd, so about 17 days ago. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference thing. To be honest, I just find it really **hard to use**. The interface feels a bit **confusing**, even after I read through the **user manual** a couple of times. I really **expected more** from the software side. I was thinking, since it's only been a little over two weeks, maybe we could work something out, like a partial credit or a discount on a different product?
I understand completely, Mark. It's important that the device feels intuitive for you. Let me just double-check the return eligibility on your order... one moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, 10 days? I thought it might be shorter. So, a full return is possible then?
Yes, absolutely. Since you're within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process a full return for you right now. No problem at all.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. That's great. Thank you, Sarah.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email within the next 15 minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Perfect. I really appreciate your help with this.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
You're welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
